summary: A loading placeholder: a grey line, circle or block with a light band sweeping across it every 1.5 s, standing in for text, an avatar or an image until the content arrives.

shape.doc: line: a pill (a line of text); circle: a disc `height` wide (an avatar); block: a rounded rectangle (an image or a card)

width.doc: Width in dp; omitted, it fills the width it is given (a circle is always `height` wide)

height.doc: Height in dp: about the text size for a line, the diameter for a circle

highlight.doc: The colour of the sweeping band

pitfalls: The sweep is a linear gradient (colour, highlight, colour) whose ends move with continuousSec(): the document repaints every frame while a skeleton is on screen, so replace it with the content as soon as it arrives
Its colours are theme colours inside the gradient (the parsers mark them as colour ids), so light and dark both work: surfaceHigh with a surface band (lighter in light, darker in dark)
Each skeleton sweeps on its own width but on the same clock, so a column of them shimmers together; the band is 240 dp wide whatever the shape
Mono has no motion and no gradient: a 1.5 dp grey outline of the shape
